content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

When traditional payment platforms impose restrictions, creators are left without viable options. NOWPayments enables crypto transactions, providing immediate access to funds without the typical delays associated with platforms like Gumroad. By utilizing a decentralized payment framework, you gain sovereignty over your revenue stream. Payments in USDT on Tron incur minimal fees, often less than $0.10 per transaction, ensuring that you retain more profit from each sale. This infrastructure empowers you to thrive in an environment where conventional options are limited.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before setting up your payment infrastructure, ensure you have a Cloudflare account, a GitHub repository for hosting your store, and a NOWPayments account. Familiarize yourself with Cloudflare Workers to manage your webhooks efficiently. Gather your digital products, such as ebooks or courses, and prepare them for upload. You will also need basic knowledge of JavaScript to customize your webhook logic. With these components in place, you can proceed to deploy your payment processing system effectively.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by deploying your Cloudflare Workers to handle incoming payment requests from NOWPayments. Configure your webhook to trigger upon payment confirmation, ensuring that customers receive their products instantly. Utilize Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, keeping track of transactions seamlessly. For file delivery, integrate Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, allowing for efficient product distribution. This setup ensures that the entire payment and delivery process operates smoothly, granting you control and reliability in managing your online store.
Instant payment confirmations mean no more waiting for payouts.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Test your payment pipeline using test transactions to confirm that your webhook functions correctly. After successful testing, launch your store and promote your digital products. Monitor the payment confirmations in real-time to ensure that everything operates as expected. With NOWPayments' automatic confirmations and low fees, you can process your first transaction confidently, paving the way for future sales. This streamlined process allows you to focus on content creation rather than payment logistics.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, consider scaling your operations. You can expand your product offerings and optimize your store for increased traffic. Use the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to enhance your infrastructure with additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for improved email deliverability. Continuously monitor your transactions and customer feedback to identify opportunities for further enhancements. By leveraging this architecture, you ensure your store is prepared for growth without the limitations of traditional payment systems.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, set up a NOWPayments account and integrate their webhooks with Cloudflare Workers. This configuration allows you to automate payment confirmations and deliver products instantly, avoiding delays faced with platforms like PayPal. With USDT payments processed on Tron or Solana, you benefit from low transaction fees and quick settlements, providing a seamless experience for your customers.
Low transaction fees on USDT and Solana keep your profits high.

Our Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides an excellent framework for your store, ensuring efficiency and scalability. Learn more about setting up your store at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a Cloudflare account to host your web applications. Set up your GitHub repository to store your product files. Register for a NOWPayments account and configure your payment methods. Deploy Cloudflare Workers to manage payment processing. Integrate your webhook with the NOWPayments API for payment confirmations. Store order data using Supabase or Google Sheets. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for product delivery. Test your entire setup with dummy transactions before launching your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Set up a NOWPayments account to process crypto payments. Integrate the NOWPayments webhook with your Cloudflare Workers to automate payment confirmations, ensuring that customers receive their products instantly after payment.
How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?
USDT payments processed on Tron reach your wallet almost instantly, often within seconds. In contrast, PayPal payments can take several days to clear, making crypto a faster option for creators.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?

Creators can use peer-to-peer exchanges like Binance or Patricia to convert Bitcoin to Naira. These platforms allow for direct trades without relying on traditional banks, ensuring quick access to local currency.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a minimal fee of 0.5% per transaction. This fee structure is competitive compared to traditional payment processors, allowing you to retain more of your earnings.
Can I sell multiple products using this setup?

Yes, you can sell multiple products using the infrastructure established with Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments. You can easily manage and scale your offerings without any limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
Own your infrastructure outright—no subscriptions or dependencies.
